newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain may alter petrol scheme as prices drop - Pique.
newsitem.headline: Spain may alter petrol scheme as prices drop - Pique.

text.p: Spanish Industry Minister Josep Pique said on Tuesday that if petrol (gasoline) prices continued to drop the government might consider doing away with the price capping system, local press reported.
On Monday, Repsol SA said it was lowering its petrol prices by as much as two pesetas a litre. Competitor CEPSA (Cia Espanola de Petroleos SA) followed suit.

Speaking in Malaga, Pique said he was "very satisfied" with the price cuts Repsol had set in motion, saying they showed that efforts to increase market competition were bearing fruit, local news agency EFE reported.
A price capping system and a surcharge of two pesetas a litre on petrol were imposed some years ago to help finance competition in distribution.
